description: This file defines a React component 'ShelfCarousel' for displaying a carousel of book items, including subcomponents for individual books and an 'Add Book' button. It manages filtering books based on search text and renders a limited number of book items.

classes.name: ShelfCarousel
classes.description: Main React component class for displaying a shelf of books with filtering and rendering logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ShelfCarousel component with props, setting initial state and search text.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that filters books if searchText is not empty after component mounts.

methods.name: filterBooks
methods.description: Filters the books in state based on the searchText, case-insensitive.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire shelf carousel including title, 'View All' link, books, and 'Add Book' button.

methods.name: renderShelfBook
methods.description: Creates an array of React elements for displaying up to 6 books.
